stages.name: RECEIVED
stages.purpose: Validate the normalized packet and record intake evidence.

stages.name: CONTEXT_LOAD
stages.purpose: Read and hash the automation canonical and policy without copying their raw contents.

stages.name: PRECHECK
stages.purpose: Verify workspace, Phase 0/1 gates, C2C health, and Phase 2 path boundaries.

stages.name: READY_FOR_ROUTING
stages.purpose: Record the routing handoff boundary without starting Phase 3 or later work.

stages.name: STOP
stages.purpose: Return one aggregate report and perform no routing, council, or execution.
